verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) and official skills for AI coding agents, so users can drive Elasticsearch through natural language. However, this depends on a separate external agent; the evidence shows no built-in natural-language command interface in the product itself. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language query or command interface, documentation of which operations are reachable via natural language through the MCP server, hands-on or independent corroboration.
